title: RAW UNREVIEWED: historical Jacea homonyms require entry-level ownership
summary: A historical plant name can cover different taxa. Build a dated, source-owned alias graph only from explicit entries with their own images and descriptions. Freeze an entry-level assignment for each Jacea/Yacea use before any f9v reading; test whether a complete reading selects one coherent source entry rather than borrowing the name from one and predicates from another. This is a raw question, not evidence for any Voynich word.

design.unit: one complete dated historical plant entry compared with one complete f9v reading
design.contrast: single-entry co-reference versus homonym splice across entries
design.prediction: a name hypothesis binds its downstream distinctive predicates to the same independently fixed historical entry
